_about: Synthetic owner notes, like the free-text a ticket, wiki page or resource description would hold. Used by the Gemini case review.
dev-sandbox-vm-07: Scratch VM for notebook experiments. Rebuilt from the base image whenever needed; nothing is stored on it.
dev-sandbox-vm-11: Runs the half-year restatement batch for finance reporting. Powered on only during close weeks, a few times a year, so long idle gaps are normal.
dev-gke-cluster: Shared development cluster used for team experiments. No customer-facing workloads run here.
prod-gke-nodepool: Hosts the order-processing services. Sized on purpose for the quarter-end peak, when order volume is several times the normal level.
staging-sql-01: Staging copy refreshed nightly from masked production data. Can be recreated from the nightly job.
lb-old-campaign: Load balancer from the spring campaign. Marketing confirmed the campaign ended and the landing pages were retired.
snap-archive-2024: Weekly snapshot, superseded by the newer snapshot series. Kept only out of habit.
